# Baver Ok
Digital Marketing · SEO · GEO · Content · Web
Zwijndrecht, Belgium | +32 470 42 48 36 | baverok@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok

## Profile
A highly motivated junior digital marketer with a strong technical foundation in web design and SEO, eager to contribute to prado's online expansion in the USA. At Episto, I manage on-page SEO, keyword-targeted content, and full-cycle WordPress site build and maintenance for client sites, tracking performance with Google Analytics and Google Ads. My independent project (mirook.com) involved applying structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines. Comfortable across content management, social media coordination, and performance reporting, I am quick to pick up new tools and platforms and passionate about growing my expertise in paid advertising, analytics, and campaign support. Based in Zwijndrecht, next to Antwerp, I am ready to bring a proactive and analytical approach to your team. Works in English and Turkish; Dutch: B1, currently taking classes to improve further.

- Analytics & reporting: Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Ads

- Content & CMS: SEO blog & content writing, editorial content publishing, website content management, WordPress site building, Canva, AI-assisted content tools
- Social: social media content & integration
- Web & build: WordPress, Elementor, Astra theme, responsive web design
- Languages: English (professional), Turkish (native), Dutch (B1)

- Build and maintain client websites in WordPress using Elementor and the Astra theme, including content uploads and page updates

- Maintained accuracy and efficiency in a high-volume, fast-paced logistics environment

## Projects

- Ran iterative technical SEO/GEO audits, measurably raising the site's overall search-health score
- Implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema, including SportsEvent and FAQPage), entity/knowledge-graph markup, and an llms.txt file to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines (GEO/AEO)
